title: Ending Credits - The Road Remembered
_note: The credits medley - the gentle exhale after the climax (the music-direction epilogue note: the bloom EXHALED instead of declared). A long-form warm retrospective: the player walks back down the whole journey in memory, and every road leads home to Tinderwick in daylight. QUOTED THEMES (reprise, never invent): bars 1-8 = dimglass-coast-a's route lead NOTE-FOR-NOTE in G major (the first road, where the journey began); bars 9-16 = lowleaf-hollow-a's Lydian-tinged glowmoss lead note-for-note (the east's wonder, the raised-4th C#); bars 17-20 = hushfrost-pass-a's stretched suspended F-minor motif note-for-note (the cold miles, the settle that hung unresolved); bars 21-24 = the TURN, the gleam-emotional minor->major pivot contour rising out of F minor through the G dominant into C (the dawn answering one last time); bars 25-32 = the Tinderwick 'Lantern Lullaby' / Vesper motif reprised WHOLE in radiant C major (the dawnstead-a daylight reading, note-for-note) - the main theme home at last. Key road: G major -> G Lydian -> F minor -> C major; the final bar's C->G half-cadence voice-leads the loop seam straight back into the G-major first road (the journey remembered again). SNES register per the standard (strings real chords, pluck harp continuity thread, sparse bell, registers bass o2 / pad o3 / lead o4 / bell o5, <=7 peak voices, era snes, render --engine chip); drums fall silent through the frost the way the pass itself was unmeasured. 100 BPM, 4/4, 32 bars (~77s loop). Render --loops 1.
key: G major -> G Lydian -> F minor -> C major

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Four memories, one voice. 1-8: Dimglass Coast's bounced route motif (quoted). 9-16: Lowleaf Hollow's airy Lydian call (quoted; bar 16 a lone C4 pickup hands G Lydian to F minor). 17-20: Hushfrost Pass's long suspended phrase (quoted). 21-24: the turn - the line climbs out of the frost, the third brightens at the G dominant, lands C. 25-32: the Tinderwick lullaby whole in C major (the daylight reading), final bar's D4 pickup leaning the loop back into the first road.

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: The warm bed under the memories. Dimglass: G-Em-C-D/G road changes. Lowleaf: G with the Lydian A-major II chord glowing through. Hushfrost: hollow Fm-Cm-Db-Fm, long and cold. The turn: Fm-Ab brightening to the G dominant and landing C. Tinderwick: the lullaby's C chords with the G turnarounds, the last bar's C->G half-cadence opening the loop back to G major.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: A soft brush groove - the road remembered at walking pace, never marching. Falls fully silent through the frost (17-22), a quiet hat re-entry on the turn, then the warm heartbeat home with one soft fill at the seam (the only flourish - an exhale, not a fanfare).
